verdict.rationale: A single marketing-oriented citation states Mistral positions Document AI for "compliance-first organizations requiring secure on-premises deployment" and offers "secure deployments," but there is no technical documentation, API/on-prem architecture, VPC networking details, or independent/hands-on confirmation that the OCR/annotation stack can actually run fully self-hosted or within a customer VPC. Missing for 10: concrete self-hosted deployment docs/architecture, VPC networking specifics, independent verification of on-prem operation, and confirmation that all document-processing features (annotation, QnA) work outside Mistral's cloud.
